summary: Scoped prototype audit: teacher admission is administrator-managed and verified-email based; personal teaching paths are authenticated-UID scoped; connection profiles and histories are protected from broad staff catch-alls. Grade revisions now require matching actor/time and before/after values, and no broad recursive write rule overrides nested history protection. Existing wider academic staff permissions remain a separate limitation, not a claim of institution-wide least privilege.

findings.issue: Bootstrap administrator and original instructor compatibility mapping remain; admission changes require active status, verified identity, sequential revision and matching immutable audit. Directory role fields and browser simulation confer no authority.
findings.recommendation: Review administrator recovery and replace legacy fallback through a controlled admission rollout before broad expansion.

findings.issue: Assignments restrict learning snapshots and dashboard queries, but existing grading, repository and shared-library staff permissions are not a complete per-class server ACL. New admitted teachers inherit those trusted academic permissions.
findings.recommendation: Authorize trusted staff only. Design and test a separate section-level academic permission migration before institution-wide onboarding.

findings.issue: Schedules, profile fields and top-level maps are bounded; personal lesson/session/deck payloads still rely partly on the Firestore document-size ceiling rather than exhaustive nested-field limits.
findings.recommendation: Add schema-specific nested text/image limits if planning payloads or usage grow.

findings.issue: Shared historical records lack reliable owner identity and are intentionally read-only; the UI does not automatically recover them into each original teacher account.
findings.recommendation: Review authorship before a separately authorized migration; keep backups and provenance.

findings.issue: Automatic maintenance remains disabled and its existing worker targets the original instructor. New teacher summaries require explicit administrator refresh.
findings.recommendation: Review multi-instructor backend processing separately; do not silently enable or deploy it.
